{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace MaxFlowContract

inductive Edge : Type where
  | mk (u : Nat) (v : Nat) (c : Nat)

def edge_u (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.mk u v c => u

def edge_v (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.mk u v c => v

def edge_c (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.mk u v c => c

def valid_input (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (source : Nat) (sink : Nat) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 8 ∧
  source < n ∧
  sink < n ∧
  source ≠ sink ∧
  (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_u e < n) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_v e < n) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_c e ≤ 9)

def solve (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (source : Nat) (sink : Nat) : Nat :=
  0

def reachable_vertices (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (source : Nat) (sink : Nat) : List Nat :=
  []

def valid_input_dec (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (source : Nat) (sink : Nat) : Bool :=
  if 2 ≤ n then
    if n ≤ 8 then
      if source < n then
        if sink < n then
          if source ≠ sink then
            if (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_u e < n) then
              if (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_v e < n) then
                if (∀ e ∈ edges, edge_c e ≤ 9) then true else false
              else false
            else false
          else false
        else false
      else false
    else false
  else false
